venue: ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing Communications and Applications

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Given the prevalence of vlogs in online platforms, automatically extracting action names from their transcripts can lead to a large-scale inexpensive action dataset.
